title: Engine Manifesto
content:
Welcome to the Photon Core documentation. This manual details the architectural decisions and instruction-level optimizations that make Photon the most efficient web engine for the Bun runtime.

Direct Native Access

Universal frameworks prioritize compatibility shims. Photon prioritizes physical throughput. By building directly on top of Bun's C++ back-end, we bypass the standard object-cloning overhead found in generic engines.

  • Bun-Native Bridge: Direct memory access to request streams without intermediate mapping.
  • AOT Compilation: Routes are pre-compiled into machine-efficient jump tables during engine startup.
  • Recycled Contexts: High-speed object pooling system that reduces Heap pressure and eliminates GC spikes.

Current benchmark data validates 91,428 RPS on a standard M3 workstation, maintaining 98.2% of the native Bun.serve throughput limit.
